title: request for quotations - u.s. embassy in panama
paragraphs: the american embassy panama invites you to submit a tender offer for services and supplies based on the below scope of work. you are encouraged to submit an offer and all prices must be submitted on a firm fixed price basis. the solicitations do not commit the american embassy panama to make any award. the embassy may cancel the solicitation or any part of it.
the american embassy panama invites you to submit a tender offer for services and supplies based on the below scope of work.

you are encouraged to submit an offer and all prices must be submitted on a firm fixed price basis. the solicitations do not commit the american embassy panama to make any award. the embassy may cancel the solicitation or any part of it.

prospective overseas offerors/quoters, if your company would like to be eligible for contract awards above us$40,000 with the u.s. government, the company shall be registered in sam.gov before sending your proposal/quotation. if you are not registered in the united states, you will need an ncage code number, you will need to request one for free by visiting the nato   codification tools webpage at: https://eportal.nspa.nato.int/codification/cagetool/home if you don’t have an account in sam, then you will need to open an account in sam.gov then, register the company in sam. gov, see below
